name: Orrath Yuzu-Miso Soft Cubes
description: Pillow-soft synth-gelatin cubes dusted in fine rice flour, combining yuzu citrus brightness with a subtle white miso umami undertone. A refined snack positioned between candy and dessert.
flavor_profile: Bright yuzu zest and a faint citrus bitterness, followed by a mellow savory-sweet miso warmth; pillowy texture that dissolves slowly; light rice flour dust on the fingers
cultural_context: Often bought as a gift item — the minimalist packaging and unusual flavor profile signal taste and restraint without the price point of real-ingredient luxury goods. Tier 4 buyers sometimes serve them at home gatherings as a conversation piece.
story_hooks: A Tier 4 corporate dinner goes wrong when a guest with a severe synth-gelatin allergy has a reaction — and the host swears they served real-ingredient sweets
Orrath's yuzu supplier is a hydroponic operation that may be operating without proper corponation licensing
The rice-flour dust has an unusually consistent particle size — someone is using the manufacturing line to process something else after hours
